requirement:
HC represents a GitHub issue by a stable owner, repository, and issue-number
identity. Reading the node supplies the issue's title, opening post, and
open/closed status as one snapshot. HC computes its fingerprint and formatted
text from that supplied snapshot through `Domain`.

For illustration:

```rust,ignore
struct GithubIssueContents {
    title: String,
    opening_post: String,
    status: IssueStatus,
}

enum IssueStatus {
    Open,
    Closed,
}
```
rationale: Add tests, marked {test} requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes, that check four things. (1) A GitHub issue node's identity is the stable owner/repository/issue-number, and the same triple always gives the same identity. (2) Reading the node supplies title, opening post, and open/closed status together as one snapshot, with both Open and Closed covered. (3) The fingerprint is computed from that supplied snapshot through `Domain`. (4) The formatted text is computed from that supplied snapshot through `Domain`. Then either implement the GitHub variant or update the {fixme} on `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]`, since issue nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26 is now closed. — The subject has no {test} references or :test: anchors. Its outgoing Tests and Implements edges are empty, and a text search found no test or code for GitHub issue nodes. Every obligation is untested: the owner/repo/number identity, the one-snapshot read of title, opening post and status, and the fingerprint and formatted text derived from that snapshot through `Domain`. The only {fixme} is on `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]`. It names nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26, which is closed, so it no longer acknowledges the gap.
